svg.aria-label: Left: the 6 by 6 plate after step 1. Value u(2,2) is highlighted and 4 arrows lead from it to the threads of cells (1,2), (3,2), (2,1) and (2,3), each of which fetches it from global memory. Right: the same plate with the number of threads that read each value: 4 in the 4 center cells, 3 along the edges of the interior, 2 in the interior corners, 1 in the boundary cells next to the interior, 0 in the 4 corners of the plate. Totals: 64 reads of 32 different values.
svg.text: Every value is read by its neighbors
In the direct kernel, value u(2, 2) is fetched from global memory by 4 threads.
global memory, each on its own.
